release.githubBundleAssets: all four identical to tested release bundle

scope: Curated public derivative of private acceptance records; not a runnable recipe, raw transcript or portable source evidence bundle.
redactions: Private repository names, source revisions and working-state details
Native task, turn, profile and environment identifiers
Full prompts, output, diffs and runtime settings
Private artifact locations and operational recovery records

functionalBaseline.boundary: Earlier functional candidate, before public documentation and package-boundary changes. Rebuilt candidate is identified by its own bundle manifest.

historical.scaffolding: Original retained rollout bytes copied unchanged; disposable lookup index and profile registration reconstructed. No command, catalog, actor, cwd or alias facts injected.

native.providerBoundary: Local scripted provider for native capture evidence; not billing or model-quality proof.

pairedCoding.boundary: One bounded pair does not establish a causal profile winner.

failedControls: An original native harness failed a read-count expectation; later post-capture verification is separate.
A repeat-definition control expected 11 skill emissions but native delivered 9; the collector retained the received rows. A corrected distinct-definition control received and retained 11.
Protected-workspace attempts failed before a corrected disposable coding recipe; original failed attempts remain retained.
A restricted fixture suite failed local listener setup; unchanged checks passed with loopback permission.

unknowns: Exhaustive native activity and guaranteed unique underlying executions
Every origin, hook, tool, plugin, alias shape and native version
Instruction adherence, billing, hidden activity and causal quality effects
Historical alias/canonical identity absent from retained source records

retention: Private originals are preserved separately and are excluded from public commits and npm packages.

releaseVerification.privacyReview: Complete outgoing objects, public snapshot and actual npm archive reviewed for known private metadata
releaseVerification.hostedChecks: No runs on final release commit; repository workflow triggers on pull requests
releaseVerification.boundary: Final immutable published source and bundle; earlier functionalBaseline remains a separate dated result.

checks: CLI help and existing profile listing
Read-only desktop observation and RAM-log status
Isolated frozen audit show/diff/export/reopen with partial exit 2
preserved: Managed entry, service configuration and log routing
localInstallation.boundary: One existing installation; no native launch, sign-in, restart, reboot or fresh-install acceptance. Detailed machine state and recovery locations remain private.
